title: Fix PolicyReplay.tsx — invalid JobFilters properties (perPage, sort)
description:
**File:** `dashboard/src/components/policy/PolicyReplay.tsx`

**Problem:** Line 104-107 passes `{ perPage: limit, sort: "-createdAt" }` to `useJobs()`, but `JobFilters` interface (hooks/useJobs.ts:16-27) doesn't have `perPage` or `sort` properties. TypeScript error TS2353.

**Root cause:** PolicyReplay was written against a different API shape than what `useJobs` actually accepts.

**Fix:** Change to `useJobs({ limit })`. The backend jobs endpoint returns most-recent first by default, so `sort` is unnecessary. The `limit` property exists on `JobFilters` and maps to the backend's `?limit=N` query parameter.
definitionOfDone: TypeScript error TS2353 in PolicyReplay.tsx is resolved
PolicyReplay correctly fetches the specified number of recent jobs
